## Indicator name

## Formula

State the formula as precisely as you can, and where it comes from (a link
is best — StockCharts ChartSchool is preferred; Fidelity, Wikipedia, or the
originating platform's own docs are good fallbacks). Formulas are always
verified against an independent source before implementation — see
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#formula-verification-is-not-optional) —
so a source link here speeds that up considerably.

## What it measures / why it's useful

A short description of what the indicator is for and how it differs from
what's already in the library (check
[the indicator index](../../docs/index.md) first — a near-duplicate of an
existing one is a good reason to close as not planned).

## Suggested category

foundations / moving_averages / oscillators / volatility / trend / volume /
advanced — pick the closest existing one, or say if it needs a new category.

## Default parameters

What the originating source uses as its default look-back / multiplier /
etc, if known.
